question: An engineer must implement protection against ICMP DoS attacks on a Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switch. The requirement is to rate-limit ICMP without denying all other ICMP traffic. The ICMP traffic currently passing through the Cisco Nexus 9000 device must not be affected. Which configuration accomplishes these goals?
options: Reconfigure the Layer 3 interfaces to be in the non-default VRF and ICMP broadcast storm control.
Create an access list deny ICMP traffic and apply it to all interfaces in the inside direction.
Apply a control plane service policy that matches all ICMP traffic to drop the traffic that exceeds the threshold.
Configure SNMP traps to send the ICMP notification if the CPU utilization is more than 90%.
